faq.q: How do I add symbols to my TikTok bio?
faq.a: Click any symbol on this page to copy it, then open TikTok → Edit profile → Bio and paste it in. The same works for captions and comments. Use dots, stars, and dividers (· ✦ ⊹ ┊) to separate lines or add a decorative accent.

faq.q: Why do some symbols not show up on TikTok?
faq.a: If a symbol appears as a blank box, the viewer's device doesn't have a glyph for that character. Common symbols (stars, hearts, arrows, dots) render almost everywhere; very new or rare characters may not. Pick a widely supported alternative if one looks broken.

faq.q: Can I use symbols in TikTok comments and usernames?
faq.a: Yes for comments and captions: paste any symbol straight in. The display/nickname field accepts most Unicode symbols too, but the unique @username (handle) is limited to letters, numbers, underscores, and periods, so decorative symbols can't go there.
